findings.title: IDOR via X-UserId Custom Authentication Header
findings.description: The application uses a custom authentication header `X-UserId` to override the session-based user ID. When a valid `X-UserId` header is provided, the application uses it instead of the session user_id without proper authorization checks. This allows any authenticated user to access any other user's data by simply changing the `X-UserId` header value. The flag user (id=10052) stores the CTF flag in the last_name field, which is displayed on the dashboard welcome message.
